hero.title: Building the Resume Tool We Wished Existed
hero.subtitle: ResumeForge started from a simple frustration: every resume builder either costs too much, collects too much data, or produces mediocre output. We built the alternative.

mission.title: Our Mission
paragraphs: We believe that creating a professional resume shouldn't require a subscription, a credit card, or handing over your personal career data to third-party advertisers.
Job hunting and academic applications are already stressful. Your resume tool should be fast, private, free, and produce beautiful documents that pass ATS filters and impress human recruiters.

values.title: Privacy First
values.description: Zero user tracking, zero server-side storage of personal information. Your data lives in your browser's localStorage and never touches our servers.

values.title: Free Forever
values.description: No paywalls, no trial periods, no locked templates, no watermark on downloads. Everything is completely free for students, researchers, and professionals.

values.title: Open & Transparent
values.description: Built with modern open web standards — Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, and React PDF. Clean code with zero hidden telemetry or tracking bloat.

values.title: Professional Grade
values.description: ATS-optimized layouts, pixel-accurate vector PDF rendering, and native Word DOCX generation that look stunning on screens and in print.

creator.name: Abdus Samad Arefi
creator.title: Creator & Lead Developer
creator.bio: A full-stack software engineer passionate about developer tools, privacy-preserving web architecture, and clean user experience design. Built ResumeForge to empower students and professionals worldwide.

cta_banner.title: Open Source & Community Driven
cta_banner.description: ResumeForge is an independent open-source project. Contribute templates, suggest features, or star us on GitHub.
